description: Bootstrap a legacy project into the idea-to-deploy methodology. Validates that /adopt by default (minimal path, ITD-PLAN-S9) writes one pointer block into CLAUDE.md (append-with-marker) that names the installed methodology and the test, lint and build commands found in the manifests; pre-existing CLAUDE.md content is preserved. .claude/settings.json, .itd/ and .itd-memory/ are written only on the strict route (/adopt strict).
